name: Critical Effects (BC): Rending - Leg
description: Black Crusade, Table 7-22 (p. 255). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: Challenging (+0) Agility Test or fall Prone and suffer Blood Loss.
Movement halved (rounding up) until medical attention. Knocked Prone and [[1d10]] Agility Damage.
Blood Loss. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or suffer 1 permanent Agility Damage.
Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or permanently lose the use of the foot. On a success, Movement is halved (rounding up). Either way, Blood Loss.
Leg broken: counts as having one leg until repaired. Blood Loss, Stunned for 1 round and knocked Prone.
Leg severed. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or die from shock. On a success: Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds and Blood Loss.
The target dies. For the rest of the battle, anyone making a Run or Charge Action within 6 metres of the corpse must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility Test or fall over.
